finalText:
Two things usually cause this.

First, a plain child re-renders whenever its parent re-renders, no matter the props. React only skips a re-render if the child is wrapped in `React.memo`.

Second, even with `React.memo`, if you pass an inline function or object (like `onClick={() => ...}` or `style={{...}}`), that's a brand new value every render. It looks the same to you but fails React's equality check.

Fix: wrap the child in `React.memo`, and wrap any function or object props in `useCallback` or `useMemo` so they keep the same reference across renders.
